title: Persist the resolved Vaporize package origin hash
description: Persist SwiftPM's refreshed origin hash so the checked-in lockfile matches the package manifest graph exercised by current Windows builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Package.resolved retains its existing dependency pins.
The refreshed origin hash is committed after successful Vaporize Windows resolution and tests.

evidence.validation: Two current Windows Vaporize test runs resolved the graph and passed with the refreshed lockfile origin hash.

resolution: Committed the resolver-produced origin hash without changing dependency pins.
